en.LIVE_TYPING_DESCRIPTION: Permet à l'orateur actuel d'écrire en direct sur l'écran du jeu.
en.DISABLE_PLAYER_COMMENTS_DESCRIPTION: Empêche les joueurs votant d'écrire des commentaires qui apparaîtront sur l'écran du jeu.
en.DISABLE_AUDIENCE_COMMENTS_DESCRIPTION: Empêche le public (non-joueurs) d'écrire des commentaires qui apparaîtront sur l'écran du jeu.
en.SKIP_WRITING_DESCRIPTION: Passe l'écriture de vos propres sujets de débat pour jouer uniquement avec des sujets préécrits.
en.SKIP_OPT_IN_DESCRIPTION: Choisir aléatoirement qui débattra deux fois lors des parties de 5 ou 7 joueurs.
en.SKIP_DRAFT: Passer le choix des sujets de débat
en.SKIP_DRAFT_DESCRIPTION: Choisir aléatoirement le sujet de débat qu'aura chaque joueur.
en.MULTI_SWITCH_DESCRIPTION: Chaque débat "changera" de sujet deux fois. La partie sera longue, mais peut-être que vous préférez comme ça ?
en.DISABLE_AWARDS_DESCRIPTION: Pas de récompenses / points seront attribués pour le plus de déplacements, sauts, commentaires, ou mots dans les commentaires.
en.EVERYBODYS_IN: En attente que %s lance la partie !
en.LOBBY_STATUS_MESSAGE_CANSTART: Appuyez quand tout le monde sera prêt
en.LOBBY_STATUS_MESSAGE_COUNTDOWN: Annuler le lancement de la partie
en.LOBBY_STATUS_MESSAGE_WAITINGFORVIP: En attente que {VIP} lance la partie !
en.LOBBY_STATUS_MESSAGE_WAITINGFORGAMEPAD: En attente du début de la partie !
en.LOBBY_PLAYER_COUNT_WARNING: S'il n'y a que deux joueurs et pas de public, il n'y aura personne pour voter lors des débats !
en.CONNECTING_DELAY:
C'est trop long...
Vérifiez votre connexion Internet.
en.MODERATION_DESCRIPTION: Les modérateurs acceptent ou refusent des sujets de débat et les commentaires des joueurs, mais pas les commentaires du public. Les modérateurs rejoignent la partie sur mod.jackbox.tv.
en.OPT_IN_INSTRUCTIONS: Décidez si vous voulez débattre deux fois !
en.HANDOFF_INSTRUCTIONS: En attente que %s lance son chrono !
TUTORIAL_COMMENTS: qui a donné un micro à ce type ? 🤐
en.TUTORIAL_SUBJECT_SWITCHED: Les tutoriels sont <font color="#FFC315">passables dans les paramètres</font>.
en.SPEAKER_POINT_HALVE_CALLOUT:
%s est dans deux débats,
les points sont coupés en deux dans chaque !
en.SWITCH_WAITING_FOR_CREATION: En attente que %s crée au moins une option de changement.
en.SWITCH_NO_EXTRA_SLOTS_LEFT: Certains joueurs n'ont pas encore créés d'option de changement, donc on vous met à part.

en.TD_NEW_VIP: %s is the new player in control of the game.
en.TD_INTROSHOT1VERSION1: A flying bird lands on a branch with a nest and eggs, facing away. It preens then turns around, revealing it's wearing Groucho glasses.
en.TD_INTROSHOT1VERSION2: A flying bird lands on a branch with a nest and eggs, facing away. It preens then turns around, revealing its head is that of a human baby.
en.TD_INTROSHOT1VERSION3: A flying bird lands on a branch with a nest and eggs, facing away. It preens then turns around, revealing it has six eyes.
en.TD_INTROSHOT2VERSION1: The name of each player fade on and off the screen as as roadside sign saying “Welcome to PERSUADIA” appears. A pair of huge legs in pink high heels walks across the road.
en.TD_INTROSHOT2VERSION2: The name of each player fade on and off the screen as as roadside sign saying “Welcome to PERSUADIA” appears. A huge fish floats across the road.
en.TD_INTROSHOT2VERSION3: The name of each player fade on and off the screen as as roadside sign saying “Welcome to PERSUADIA” appears. A giraffe wearing sungalsses and driving a convertible falls from the sky and lands on the road and drives away.
en.TD_INTROSHOT3VERSION1: The logo for the game, Debate and Switch, fades on screen over an aerial shot of Persuadia High School. A flying saucer passes overhead.
en.TD_INTROWALKON: The host, Patsy, walks to her desk carrying a stack of papers. When she puts them down, they disperse, revealing her face.

en.TD_LOSE_ANIMATION_0: %s loses. An aerosol can sprays on their avatar, which grows a ton of hair, enveloping them.
en.TD_LOSE_ANIMATION_1: %s loses. A toaster flies up behind their avatar, landing and enveloping them. They are ejected from the toaster, now a piece of toast.
en.TD_LOSE_ANIMATION_2: %s loses. Three pies hit their avatar, covering them with filling. Their eyes appear through the dripping mess.
en.TD_LOSE_ANIMATION_3: %s loses. A ray gun appear from the ceiling, shooting at their avatar, turning them into a duck.
en.TD_LOSE_ANIMATION_4: %s loses. Their avatar solidifies then crumbles into pieces, their eyes blinking as they fall onto the podium.
en.TD_LOSE_ANIMATION_5: %s loses. A flying saucer appears, pausing over their avatar before a beam shoots down and abducts them.
en.TD_LOSE_ANIMATION_6: %s loses. Their avatar folds into a paper crane. The crane's wings flap.
en.TD_LOSE_ANIMATION_7: %s loses. A cloud appears over their avatar and begins to rain. They grow plants and flowers all over their body, enveloping them.
en.TD_LOSE_ANIMATION_8: %s loses. Their avatar's head inflates like a balloon, then detatches from their body, revealing a knot in their neck and a string hanging down.
en.TD_LOSE_ANIMATION_9: %s loses. A giant hand appears above their avatar, first pressing down with its pointer finger, then punching downwards, smushing them.
en.TD_WIN_ANIMATION_0: %s wins. Their avatar raises their hand and winks.
en.TD_WIN_ANIMATION_1: %s wins. Their avatar gives a thumbs up and smiles.
en.TD_WIN_ANIMATION_2: %s wins. Their avatar raises their hand and smiles.
en.TD_WIN_ANIMATION_3: %s wins. Their avatar raises both hands up in celebration.
en.TD_WIN_ANIMATION_4: %s wins. Their avatar rests their chin on their hands and winks.
en.TD_WIN_ANIMATION_5: %s wins. Their avatar claps their hands together and smiles.
en.TD_WIN_ANIMATION_6: %s wins. Their avatar gives a thumbs up and winks.
en.TD_WIN_ANIMATION_7: %s wins. Their avatar raises both fists close to their body and smiles.
en.TD_WIN_ANIMATION_8: %s wins. Their avatar's rosy checks spread to their whole face as they blush.
en.TD_WIN_ANIMATION_9: %s wins. Their avatar flexes their right arm and arches their left eyebrow.
